# Node API (Fastify or Express, PostgreSQL with Prisma or pg, Redis and Socket.io when used)

These rules add to the core build skills of Shipwright.

## Rules

- Validation schema on every route (Fastify JSON schema or Zod): body, params, querystring and relevant headers.
- Security plugins: @fastify/helmet, @fastify/rate-limit, @fastify/cors with an explicit origin list (or helmet, express-rate-limit, cors).
- If the project uses Socket.io: authenticate on connection, validate every incoming event, rate-limit per socket, Redis adapter as soon as there is more than one instance.
- If the project uses Prisma: migrations with prisma migrate, never db push in production; $queryRaw only with parameters; prisma.$transaction for related writes.
- If the project uses the pg driver: parameterised queries only ($1, $2), never SQL built by concatenation; versioned SQL migrations applied by one tool; one Pool per process, closed on shutdown.
- Several customers in the same tables: PostgreSQL row-level security (enabled and forced), the app connected as a role that neither bypasses RLS nor owns the tables, the customer set per transaction with set_config('app.org_id', $1, true) in one function (withOrg) that every route uses. Prisma and pg examples: references/row-level-security.md.
- If the project uses Redis: password, local binding, keys with expiry for temporary data.
- Structured logs with pino, no personal data; request ID in every log line.
- /health route that checks the database (and Redis when used); SIGTERM handling with clean shutdown.

## Check commands

Used by `/sw:audit`. `{pm}` is the project's package manager, `{url}` the app URL, `{api_url}` the API URL (project.json `api_url`, the app URL when absent), `{host}` its host name.

| Check | Command | Passes if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | `{pm} exec tsc --noEmit` | exit code 0 |
| lint | `{pm} run lint` | exit code 0, no errors |
| test_run | `{pm} test` | exit code 0 |
| e2e | `{pm} run test:e2e` | exit code 0 (API tests against a test database) |
| deps_audit | `{pm} audit --audit-level=high` | no high or critical advisory |
| license_check | `npx --yes license-checker-rseidelsohn --summary --failOn 'GPL;AGPL'` | exit code 0. If npx --yes is not allowed, install it once as a dev dependency ({pm} add -D license-checker-rseidelsohn) and run it without --yes |
| load_test | `npx --yes autocannon -c 100 -d 30 {api_url}/health` | 0 errors; then repeat on the 3 busiest routes. The address is project.json › api_url (the API's own address, e.g. http://localhost:3001), or the app URL when the API is served there. If npx --yes is not allowed, install the tool once as a dev dependency ({pm} add -D autocannon) and run it without --yes |
